In each M=2^d block, the transitions at (k+1)M-2^j with j up to min(d-1,v2(k+1)), and a valuation/XOR boundary event, give exactly the listed gap lengths. Conditioning on v2 and odd residue classes yields all rational per-length frequencies and the sum 8(M-1)/(3M^2). Independently checked 458752 transitions for d=2..8 plus exact frequency mass and mean identities. This is correct mathematics, but it was already published.
